dialogues.speaker: Trapped Toytanium Miner
dialogues.text: After the toytanium mines collapsed, we were trapped here...

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Toytanium Miner
dialogues.text: There was nothing but hard toytanium all about, surrounding us! We could only dig deeper...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've already blown a path through!

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Toytanium Miner
dialogues.text: But... We may have delved too deep, we can't get back up...

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Toytanium Miner
dialogues.text: If only there was some <color=#00E1FFFF>wind</color> to give us a push...

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Toytanium Miner
dialogues.text: Wind! There's wind! We can ascend! Thank you, thank you so much!
